articles.title: Fake GTA VI ISO circulates on the internet a few days after leak, internet sleuths claim 113GB download is padded malware - testers claim file is 99.99% empty zeroes with 50KB virus embedded
articles.description: A 113GB GTA VI ISO file is circulating on the internet, with its file name making it seem like it was the game build that Cyberleek is allegedly in possession of. But upon further investigation, it appears to just be a 50KB virus padded with zeroes to make it look like the real thing.
